title: giveOpinion (client → server)
description: Participant only (FR-015c): the facilitator gets error FORBIDDEN, they move the card instead. AGREE, RAISE, LOWER: "D'accord", "Je monterais", "Je descendrais". One opinion per member, feature and criterion: a new one replaces the previous one; opinion null withdraws it with its comment. comment is optional and never required: absent, a changed opinion keeps the previous comment; an empty string clears it. value is the value the member would give, on the session scale (error INVALID_VALUE otherwise), only with RAISE or LOWER (error INVALID_MESSAGE with AGREE): absent or null, a RAISE or LOWER keeps the previous value of the same opinion, and a changed opinion loses it. A feature outside the draft or a criterion outside draft.criterionKeys gets error NOT_IN_RANKING; without an open room, error NO_RANKING_IN_PROGRESS.
